regime_context: Hong Kong thematic state shows Tech Hardware & Semis as the clear leader (rank 1, trend-eligible, no crowding), but with very narrow breadth (0.17). The absolute-trend gate is validated for drawdown control, which supports overweighting eligible trend themes as a risk discipline, not a return forecast. All top themes lack ETF proxies, limiting scoreability.
emerging_watch: Diversified Miners (hk_miners, rank 2) is the closest challenger with a strong score. It is currently ineligible (no trend gate pass), but if it gains eligibility and the margin to Tech Hardware narrows below 0.3, a confirmed handoff could emerge. Kill criterion: margin widens beyond 1.0 or miners remain ineligible for 10 days.
